description: Central Provincial Council - Vesting of powers under co-operative societies statute of the Central Provincial Council to Mrs. M. M. I. Menikdiwela
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Sarath Ekanayake) and provides detailed portfolio responsibilities (Minister of Finance and Planning, Law and Peace, Local Government, etc.). It also contains both the appointment of officers (Mrs. W. M. I. Menikdiwela) and detailed descriptions of their empowered duties and regulatory powers under specific statutes. The content includes both "who" (government persons) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities), making it a Hybrid Gazette.
